cleaningGuide.title: How to clean

intro.title: Why cleaning matters
intro.text: The Kingdom Hall is the congregation's main place of worship. It should represent Jehovah and his organization worthily, inside and out. Regular cleaning protects the health of everyone attending and reflects our deep faith and love for the brothers.

principles.title: Cleaning principles
principles.i2: A small amount of cleaner is enough
principles.i4: Use the right cleaner for each area
principles.i7: Don't rinse a used cloth — take a fresh one

safety.title: Safety
safety.i2: Put out the “Caution! Wet floor” sign when mopping
safety.i3: Use ladders carefully: face the steps, never stand on the top step
safety.i4: Route the vacuum cable so nobody trips over it
safety.i5: Spray cleaner onto the cloth, not onto the surface

wc.zsk1: Pour cleaner into the toilet and scrub with the brush
wc.zsk2: Wipe the seat, lid and tank with a red cloth
wc.zsk3: Pour cleaner into the urinal and scrub with the brush
wc.zsk4: Wipe the urinal outside and the partition next to it
wc.weekly1: Apply cleaner to toilet and urinal, let it work for 5 minutes
wc.weekly2: With gloves on, wash the seat on both sides, the rim and the wall nearby
wc.weekly3: Wash the toilet outside on all sides, plus the brush and its holder
wc.weekly4: With gloves on, clean the urinal inside with a pad
wc.weekly5: Wash the urinal outside, the partition and the surrounding wall

sanitary.zsk1: Wipe the door handles on both sides
sanitary.zsk2: Wipe the sink, tap and the shelf above it
sanitary.zsk3: Wipe dispensers, holders and cubicle handles
sanitary.weekly1: Wash the door completely, including handles and edges
sanitary.weekly2: Scrub the sink with a pad and cleaner
sanitary.weekly3: Wash the sink, shelf and surrounding wall, underneath too
sanitary.weekly4: Wash cubicle partitions, dispensers and holders
sanitary.yearly1: Deep-clean the doors on all sides
sanitary.yearly2: Wash soap and paper dispensers inside and out
sanitary.yearly3: Wash all washroom surfaces: walls, doors, cubicles

floors.zsk1: First mop along the edges and corners
floors.zsk2: Mop the whole floor in a figure-eight motion
floors.zsk3: Hang mops up to dry; used ones go to the laundry

furniture.zsk1: Wipe the doors and door handles
furniture.zsk2: Wipe the lectern and the stands
furniture.zsk4: Wipe the cabinets outside and their handles
furniture.weekly1: Brush the chair seats and backrests
furniture.weekly2: Wash the lectern and the stands with a damp cloth
furniture.weekly3: Wash the coat racks and hooks
furniture.yearly1: Wash the chairs completely, including frame and legs
furniture.yearly2: Vacuum the chair upholstery with the nozzle
furniture.yearly3: Deep-clean all doors on every side
furniture.yearly4: Empty the cabinets and wash them inside and out

glass.zsk1: Remove spots from mirrors — spray cleaner onto the cloth
glass.zsk2: Remove fingerprints from the glass doors
glass.weekly1: Wash the mirrors completely, including frames
glass.weekly2: Wet the glass with the washer from the bucket
glass.weekly3: Squeegee the water off, wiping the blade after each pass
glass.weekly4: Wash frames and window sills, rinsing the cloth

kitchen.weekly1: Wipe the fronts, handles and appliance exteriors

my.permanent: You serve as a regular pioneer — no auxiliary application is needed.
my.committeeIncomplete: Applying in the app is not possible yet: the service committee is not complete. You can give the paper form to the coordinator of the body of elders.
my.inviteText: Fill in the application — it goes straight to the service committee. If you prefer paper, give the form to the coordinator of the body of elders.
my.takeBackText: The application disappears and the committee will no longer see it. You can apply again at any time.
my.stopText: Choose your last month of service. The service committee will be notified.

form.title: Application
form.untilCancelledHint: Serve every month until you stop. The chosen tile is the first month.
form.goalTitle: Goal in the months that allow 15 hours
form.words1: I would like to share more fully in the ministry because I love Jehovah and want to help others learn about him. So I would like to serve as an auxiliary pioneer.
form.words2: I maintain high moral standards and good habits. I have planned my time so that I can meet the hour requirement.
form.words2Sister: I maintain high moral standards and good habits. I have planned my time so that I can meet the hour requirement.
form.lateHint: The form asks for the application a week before you begin. You can still apply now — the committee will decide.

view.title: Application
view.questions: 1. Is the applicant an exemplary Christian with high moral standards? 2. Is there any reason he may not serve as a pioneer? 3. Have you consulted the applicant's group overseer? The answers are not recorded anywhere.
view.openSeat: Open the place “{{seat}}” to other elders
view.passText: Any other elder will be able to answer instead of you. The publisher will not be told.
view.withdrawText: The application disappears without notifying the publisher. The other two brothers of the committee will be told. Speak with the publisher personally.
view.openText: The brother in the place “{{seat}}” has not answered for three days. Any other elder will be able to answer instead.
view.unfillable: nobody left to answer — two are enough

open.applicant: {{name}} is the applicant — another elder answers

seat.body_coordinator: Coordinator of the body of elders

paper.title: Paper application

s21Totals.intro: Each month’s totals on three cards — as the month went to the branch. A late report stands in the month whose report it went into; on the person’s own S-21 it stays in its own month.

pioneers.title: Regular pioneers, special pioneers and missionaries

s21Totals.lateHint: By the instruction a late report goes into the next month’s report — so here it stands in the month it was sent in. Special pioneers and missionaries are not in the congregation’s report, but card 1 counts them.

iosHomeScreen.title: Print from Safari
iosHomeScreen.body: In the app opened from the Home Screen icon, iPhone and iPad do not allow printing — an iOS limitation. Open mycongregation.org in Safari and tap the printer there: printing works.

viaSafari.title: Ready to print
viaSafari.body: It opens in Safari, where the print window appears at once. The link works for 10 minutes.

pioneerHistory.title: Pioneer service history
pioneerHistory.empty: Never served as a permanent pioneer — or earlier service has not been copied in from the paper S-21 yet.
pioneerHistory.knownFromEdit: Earlier service — from the paper S-21 and former congregations — can be added. First known month: {{month}}
pioneerHistory.hint: Regular, special pioneer or missionary — from the paper S-21 card. Auxiliary pioneering is kept elsewhere. The service running now is changed on the card itself.
pioneerHistory.removeBody: {{kind}}, {{range}}. Delete it only if it was entered by mistake.

pioneerEnd.title: Pioneer service ended
pioneerEnd.beforeStart: Service began in {{month}} — the last month cannot be earlier.
pioneerEnd.reports: From {{month}} on — a publisher’s report, without hours
pioneerEnd.s1: On the S-1 — on the publishers’ line, not the regular pioneers’
pioneerEnd.s1Special: The report goes to the congregation and onto the publishers’ line of the S-1
pioneerEnd.year: The committee measures the service year only by the months he pioneered
pioneerEnd.history: In the service history the «{{kind}}» stretch closes with {{month}}
pioneerEnd.sent: The S-1 for {{months}} has already gone with him on a pioneer line. What was sent stays as it was.
pioneerEnd.hours: The reports for {{months}} came with hours — they stay as they are.
pioneerEnd.hint: If he starts again, a new appointment on the card opens a new stretch.

noQuota.title: Service without an hours requirement
noQuota.lead: For exemplary pioneers whose health keeps them from the requirement. The elders decide, after speaking with the circuit overseer (point 9).
noQuota.ageUnknown: No birth date on the card
noQuota.ageIs: {{age}} — by the birth date on the card
noQuota.yearsIs: {{span}} by the service history. First known month: {{month}}; years on paper cards may add to it.
noQuota.note: The whole service year of the decision is free of the requirement, and every year after until the mark is taken off. The branch is not told. The S-21 notes it under remarks.
noQuota.endBody: This service year stays free; the requirement returns with the next one.

pioneerMeeting.title: Annual meeting of the elders with the pioneers
pioneerMeeting.about: Once a year, in December or January, an elder chosen by the body meets the regular and special pioneers and the missionaries serving in the field — on the outline S-211.
pioneerMeeting.whoHint: Invited are the regular and special pioneers and missionaries serving on the day of the meeting. The list keeps itself: a pioneer appointed later is invited too.
pioneerMeeting.lead: The invited and the conducting elder are notified, and reminded the evening before. The conductor is also reminded a week ahead.
pioneerMeeting.cancelBody: The invited and the conductor are told it is canceled.

warn.outsideSeason: The instructions place the meeting in December or January.
warn.conductorAway: The conductor is away that day.
